# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` in the repository root: the project rules, commands, where to work and how a
pull request lands. In short: write the failing test first and never loosen a test; work in a git
worktree; never force-push; Conventional Commits with a body; user-visible changes update
`docs/guide.md`; security-sensitive changes update `docs/security.md` and get a fresh review.
